author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam assembles a replica of one of the more distinct props from the original Blade Runner: the uniquely shaped whiskey bottle that must have been custom made for the film. This bottle, dubbed "The Deckanter" is the best replica Adam has seen of the prop, down to its wax seal and label details. 

Deckanter made by Mark Nelson at 550 P.E.D.: https://www.facebook.com/550PED/
Mark Raats paintings and poster art: https://markraats.com/

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
